name: Two Italian pensions of someone living abroad: IRPEF on their total, shared between them
workings: Living under a system with no treaty rules here: Italy taxes what the plan says, with no warning
Each pension gets its share of each line in proportion to its amount (3 to 1)
Pension detrazione (non-residents keep the art. 13 detrazioni): 0 (R above 50,000)
Addizionale regionale at Lazio's rates (INPS's seat): 1.73% × 28,000.00 + 2.33% × 22,000.00 + 3.33% × 10,000.00 = 1,330.00
